_comment: Research analysis manifest: reads three research papers and extracts structured key findings from each. Uses opus for higher-quality extraction, plan permission mode so each step can be reviewed, and restricts tools to Read-only to prevent accidental modifications.

tasks.name: extract-findings-paper-1
tasks.prompt: Read the file papers/climate-feedback-loops.pdf and extract the key findings. Produce a structured summary with the following sections: (1) Research Question, (2) Methodology, (3) Key Findings as a numbered list, (4) Limitations, (5) Implications. Be precise and quote directly from the paper where appropriate.
